faqs.q: What is a magnetic-pickup proximity sensor with a 5/8-18 UNF thread used for?
faqs.a: It is a magnetic-pickup sensor used as a bolt-counter on triplex and quintuplex pump crank shafts, feeding RPM and calculated displacement to the unit data acquisition system. It has a 5/8-18 UNF body and an M12 4-pin connector; see the [proximity sensors shelf](/c/ic-proximity-sensors).

faqs.q: What does the magnetic pickup sensor measure?
faqs.a: Shaft speed: it counts the passing bolts on a pump crank shaft, which gives stroke or RPM and, calculated, displacement. The output feeds the unit DAQ.

faqs.q: What thread and connector does the proximity sensor have?
faqs.a: A 5/8-18 UNF threaded body with an M12 4-pin connector. Check the mounting hole thread on your pump. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: Does the magnetic pickup sensor need a power supply?
faqs.a: No, no onboard power is required: the output is a passive signal proportional to shaft speed. It connects straight to the DAQ input. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: Is the magnetic pickup sensor available for hazardous areas?
faqs.a: Hazardous-area-rated variants are available. Tell us the zone and certification when you ask. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: What signal does the proximity sensor give?
faqs.a: A passive signal proportional to shaft speed, which a [data acquisition system](/p/multi-channel-data-acquisition-system-15-inch-touchscreen-usb-export-frac-fleet-ready) reads as a frequency input. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: Which pumps use the magnetic pickup proximity sensor?
faqs.a: Triplex and quintuplex pumps on frac and cementing units, where the sensor reads the crank shaft bolts. It reports stroke count for each unit.

faqs.q: How is the magnetic pickup sensor installed?
faqs.a: Screw the 5/8-18 UNF body into the mounting hole so it faces the bolt heads at the right gap, and connect the M12 plug to the DAQ cable. See the [oilfield instrumentation guide](/blog/oilfield-pressure-and-flow-instrumentation).

faqs.q: What do I need to tell Indus to quote the the magnetic-pickup proximity sensor?
faqs.a: Quote the full title, Magnetic-Pickup Proximity Sensor, 5/8-18 UNF, M12 Connector, Stroke / RPM Counter, with the variant, size or voltage you need, and say where it will be used and which standard or zone applies. We confirm the specification and lead time on the quotation; start on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Why count strokes on a triplex pump?
faqs.a: Stroke count and calculated displacement tell the DAQ how much fluid the pump has moved, which is used with the [flowmeters](/c/ic-turbine-flowmeters) to check the job.

faqs.q: Where is the proximity sensor supplied from?
faqs.a: We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide. Send the thread and connector you need. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: Is the magnetic-pickup proximity sensor in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we hold the magnetic-pickup proximity sensor in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).
